topics.title: Running example through the method
topics.why: Agents agreed (Q1) that one plot should be followed through the three stages.

items.old: The method has three stages that run every morning on each plot.
items.new: The method has three stages that run every morning on each plot. Throughout the chapter, the tomato plot of Farm B — the farm with the only failed plot-season (§4.3) — is followed through all three.
items.desc: Introduce the running example once, in the overview.

items.old: The evaluation covers one crop, three farms and two seasons.
items.new: The answer holds for one crop under the conditions of three farms; it says nothing yet about crops with deeper roots.
items.desc: Speak about the limits of the answer, not of the design (threats stay in §4.5).

items.old: Three pilot farms are a small sample, and the plots were chosen by the farmers.
items.new: Three pilot farms are a small sample. The plots were chosen by the farmers, which may favour well-kept plots.
items.desc: Name the direction of the selection bias.
